City Library Reopens After Renovation

The City Central Library reopened on Monday after a six-month renovation, unveiling expanded reading rooms and upgraded public computer stations. Officials said the changes were designed to improve access for students, families, and remote workers.

Library Director Maria Chen noted that the building now includes additional quiet-study areas and a redesigned children’s section. “We wanted the space to feel more welcoming and easier to navigate,” Chen said during the opening event.

Residents began returning to the library shortly after doors opened, with many signing up for new library cards and reserving seats in the updated study rooms. The library will resume its regular schedule this week, including evening hours on weekdays and community programs on Saturdays.
